plainText:
Haruka Shamoto (Japanese: 社本悠 Shamoto Haruka) is a Japanese voice actress for and .

==Biography==
Shamoto was born on Nov 12 in Aichi Prefecture, Japan and became an actress as an adult. She joined the during , where she voiced one of Chloe's classmates. Later on in the series, Shamoto began to voice additional characters and Pokémon. She returned in , voicing a Pokémon Center lady.
